reason: Frequently used to describe the quality of actions or states.

exampleKo: 아이들이 공원에서 공을 던지며 신나게 놀고 있었어요.
hint: to throw, to cast; a common verb for physical actions.
reason: Basic verb for a common physical action.

exampleKo: 이 카페는 공부하기에 좋은 조용하고 넓은 공간을 제공합니다.
hint: space, room, area; refers to physical or abstract areas.
reason: Abstract noun applicable to various contexts.

meaningEn: to start, to begin, to wage (a war), to set up (a business)
exampleKo: 친구와 함께 작은 사업을 벌이기로 결정했어요.

reason: Useful for describing the initiation of activities, especially business.

exampleKo: 선생님은 시험에서 중요한 부분을 다시 한번 강조하셨어요.
hint: to emphasize, to stress; used when highlighting the importance of something.
reason: Key verb for expressing importance in academic and professional settings.

meaningEn: to take charge of, to undertake, to smell
exampleKo: 새로운 프로젝트를 맡게 되어서 책임감이 더 커졌어요.

reason: Essential for discussing roles and responsibilities in work and projects.

meaningEn: on the other hand, meanwhile, at the same time
exampleKo: 그는 열심히 공부했지만, 한편으로는 건강도 잘 챙겼습니다.
hint: on the other hand, meanwhile, at the same time; used to present contrasting or simultaneous ideas.
reason: Crucial for logical connections and expressing complex viewpoints.

exampleKo: 그 기자는 사건의 진실을 밝히기 위해 밤샘 취재를 했어요.
hint: reporter, journalist; often used in news contexts.
reason: Common profession relevant to media and society.

exampleKo: 우리 회사는 주로 젊은 고객층을 대상으로 제품을 판매합니다.
hint: mainly, primarily, mostly; indicates the main focus or tendency.
reason: High frequency adverb crucial for expressing main points.

exampleKo: 어제보다 오늘은 날씨가 훨씬 따뜻해서 활동하기 좋아요.
hint: much, far, a lot (for comparison); emphasizes the degree of difference.
reason: Essential adverb for comparative sentences, frequent in all sections.

exampleKo: 많은 사람들이 한반도의 평화로운 통일을 염원하고 있습니다.
hint: unification, unity; often refers to political or social unification.
reason: Key concept in Korean society and politics.

meaningEn: to enter, to step into, to be built/established
exampleKo: 새로운 상점이 우리 동네에 들어서면서 분위기가 활기차졌어요.

reason: Versatile verb applicable to various contexts, including social changes.

exampleKo: 이 체육관은 최신 운동 시설을 갖추고 있어서 인기가 많아요.
hint: facility, equipment, installation; refers to structures or tools for a purpose.
reason: Commonly used when discussing infrastructure, education, and public spaces.

exampleKo: 학교 주변에 맛있는 식당이 많아서 점심시간이 항상 기다려져요.
hint: surroundings, vicinity, area; refers to the space around a location or person.
reason: High utility for describing locations and social contexts.

exampleKo: 바빠서 회의에 참석하지 못했지만, 대신 동료가 내용을 전달해 주었어요.
hint: instead, in place of; used to indicate a substitution or alternative.
reason: Important conjunction/adverb for expressing alternatives and replacements.

exampleKo: 줄을 서서 자기 차례를 기다리는 것이 중요합니다.
hint: turn, order, sequence; also ancestral rites. Primarily used for order in this context.
reason: Commonly used for sequence and order in daily life and formal settings.

exampleKo: 우리 가족은 여름 휴가 때 강원도 양양군으로 여행을 갔어요.
hint: county, military/army; often used as a geographical administrative unit (e.g., 강원도 양양군).
reason: Geographical term relevant for location descriptions, especially in TOPIK writing.

exampleKo: 그분은 평생 열심히 일해서 많은 재산을 모았어요.
hint: property, assets, fortune. Often used in contexts of wealth and inheritance.
reason: Commonly appears in economic and social contexts.

exampleKo: 날씨가 약간 추워서 따뜻한 옷을 입어야겠어요.
hint: a little, a bit, slightly. Modifies adjectives or adverbs.
reason: High frequency adverb, useful for nuanced expression.

exampleKo: 회사는 직원들에게 더 많은 노력을 요구했습니다.
hint: to demand, to request. Implies a strong desire or need.
reason: Key verb for expressing needs and demands in various social situations.

exampleKo: 이 프로젝트는 짧은 기간 안에 끝내야 합니다.
hint: period, term, duration. Refers to a specific length of time.
reason: Essential for discussing time frames in projects, contracts, etc.

meaningEn: to raise, to cause, to provoke
exampleKo: 그 사건은 사회에 큰 파장을 일으켰어요.
hint: to raise, to cause, to provoke. Often used with abstract nouns like 'problem' or 'effect'.
reason: Versatile verb for discussing causes and effects.

exampleKo: 우리 회사는 새로운 제품을 생산하기 위해 공장을 확장하고 있습니다.
hint: factory, plant. A place where goods are manufactured.
reason: Relevant for economic and industrial topics.

exampleKo: 저는 주말에 친구들과 함께 영화 보는 것을 즐겨요.
hint: to enjoy, to have fun. Expresses pleasure and satisfaction.
reason: Common verb for expressing enjoyment in leisure and cultural activities.

exampleKo: 계절이 변하면 사람들의 옷차림도 변해요.
hint: to change, to transform. Indicates a shift from one state to another.
reason: Fundamental verb for describing change in various contexts.

hint: accident, incident; thought, thinking. Context is key to meaning.
reason: Important for discussing safety, societal issues, and abstract thought.

exampleKo: 아무리 바빠도 아침 식사는 꼭 챙겨 먹어야 해요.
hint: no matter how, however much. Used to emphasize a condition or effort.
reason: Useful adverb for expressing concession and emphasis.

meaningEn: to adjust, to fit, to match
exampleKo: 우리는 서로의 의견을 맞추기 위해 계속 이야기했어요.
hint: to adjust, to fit, to match; often used with abstract concepts like opinions or schedules
reason: Useful for expressing agreement and coordination.

exampleKo: 한국 사람들은 매일 밥을 먹기 때문에 쌀이 중요해요.
hint: rice (uncooked); fundamental food item in Korea

reason: Versatile verb applicable to physical and abstract blocking.

hint: to throw away, to discard; common action related to possessions
reason: Frequent verb for actions involving disposal.

meaningEn: to stick, to attach, to paste
exampleKo: 벽에 예쁜 그림을 붙여서 방 분위기를 바꿨어요.
hint: to stick, to attach, to paste; used for physical attachment or naming
reason: Common verb for actions of attaching or affixing.

exampleKo: 그는 늘 아침 일찍 일어나서 운동을 합니다.
hint: always, constantly, habitually; indicates frequency or regularity
reason: High-frequency adverb essential for describing habits and routines.

exampleKo: 이번 주말에는 전국적으로 비가 올 예정입니다.
hint: the whole country, nationwide; refers to the entire territory of a country
reason: Useful for discussing national events or scope.

exampleKo: 저는 오늘 숙제를 마치고 친구들과 놀러 갈 거예요.
hint: to finish, to complete; used for tasks, work, or studies
reason: Essential verb for discussing completion of activities.

exampleKo: 어려운 일이 있을 때 친구들의 도움이 정말 컸어요.
hint: help, aid, assistance; a key concept in social interactions
reason: Crucial noun for expressing and receiving support.

reason: Frequent use in various contexts, including abstract concepts like being absorbed in something.

reason: Relevant for environmental and economic discussions, though less frequent than other terms.

exampleKo: 회의에서 모두가 자신의 의견을 자유롭게 발표했습니다.
hint: opinion, view. Expressing personal thoughts and perspectives.
reason: Crucial for expressing oneself in discussions, writing, and understanding others' viewpoints.

exampleKo: 자신의 감정을 솔직하게 표현하는 것이 중요하다고 생각해요.
hint: to express, to show. Communicating feelings, thoughts, or intentions.
reason: Fundamental verb for communication and self-expression in all TOPIK sections.

meaningEn: to be strange, to be weird, to be unusual
exampleKo: 오늘따라 날씨가 좀 이상하네요. 갑자기 비가 올 것 같아요.
hint: to be strange, to be weird, to be unusual. Describes something out of the ordinary.
reason: Commonly used adjective for describing situations or things.

hint: to stick, to attach, to pass (an exam). Has both physical and figurative meanings.
reason: Useful for describing physical actions and the important concept of passing exams.

exampleKo: 주말에 친구들과 함께 축구 경기를 보러 갈 예정이에요.
hint: game, match; economy. Refers to sports events and economic conditions.
reason: Covers both sports and economic contexts, making it broadly applicable.

exampleKo: 이 프로젝트의 주된 목적은 새로운 기술을 개발하는 것입니다.
hint: purpose, aim, goal. The reason for doing something.
reason: Essential abstract noun for discussing plans, goals, and intentions.

exampleKo: 어려운 상황에서도 긍정적인 태도를 유지하는 것이 중요해요.

reason: Commonly used abstract noun for describing behavior and opinions.

reason: Useful for describing locations and safety awareness.

hint: stop, no more; used to cease an action or state
reason: Common adverb for indicating cessation, often part of compound verbs.

meaningEn: to occur, to happen, to arise
exampleKo: 갑자기 문제가 발생해서 회의가 예정보다 늦게 시작되었어요.
hint: to occur, to happen, to arise; used for events, especially problems or accidents
reason: Essential verb for discussing events and issues in various contexts.

reason: Useful for expressing chance occurrences and unexpected situations.

exampleKo: 이 케이크를 만드는 데 필요한 재료가 모두 준비되어 있나요?
hint: ingredient, material; refers to components used in cooking, building, etc.
reason: Versatile noun applicable to cooking, crafts, and construction.

exampleKo: 학생들은 각각 다른 주제를 선택해서 발표를 준비했어요.
hint: each, severally, respectively; used to indicate individual items or people
reason: Important adverb for distinguishing and enumerating items.

meaningEn: to move, to transfer, to convey
exampleKo: 무거운 책상을 다른 방으로 옮기는 것을 좀 도와주시겠어요?
hint: to move, to transfer, to convey; physical relocation or transmission
reason: Common verb for actions involving movement and relocation.

exampleKo: 자신의 행동에 대한 책임을 지는 것은 매우 중요합니다.

hint: to be changed, to be replaced; common for plans, situations, or objects
reason: Very common verb for changes in plans or situations, crucial for comprehension.

meaningEn: to be severe, to be intense, to be extreme
exampleKo: 요즘 미세먼지가 너무 심해서 외출할 때 마스크를 꼭 써야 해요.
hint: to be severe, to be intense, to be extreme; used for negative conditions like pollution, illness, or criticism
reason: Useful for describing negative phenomena in environment, health, and social issues.

exampleKo: 아니, 벌써 퇴근 시간이라고요? 시간이 정말 빠르네요.
hint: no, well, oh no; interjection used to express surprise, disagreement, or mild negation
reason: Basic interjection, too elementary for TOPIK II extension.

exampleKo: 아이들은 부모님의 사랑과 관심 속에서 건강하게 자라야 해요.
hint: to grow, to grow up; used for children, plants, or abstract things like economy
reason: Common verb for growth, relevant to social and personal development topics.

exampleKo: 좀 더 구체적인 예를 들어 설명해주시면 이해하기 쉬울 것 같아요.
hint: concrete, specific; used to ask for or provide detailed information
reason: Essential for logical reasoning and detailed explanations in writing and speaking.

exampleKo: 이번이 한국어를 배울 수 있는 좋은 기회이니 놓치지 마세요.
hint: opportunity, chance; often used with '좋은' (good) or '잡다' (to seize)

hint: Earth, globe; often used in contexts of environment, geography, and global issues
reason: Key term for environmental and scientific topics, frequently appearing in news and discussions.

exampleKo: 이 제품은 특히 젊은 소비자들에게 인기가 많다고 합니다.
hint: consumer; refers to people who buy goods or services
reason: Central term in economic and consumption-related topics, important for reading and writing.

exampleKo: 어떤 기준으로 이 회사에서 신입 사원을 채용하는지 궁금해요.
hint: standard, criterion; a basis for judgment or decision-making
reason: Essential for comparative analysis, evaluation, and setting standards in various contexts.

exampleKo: 내일까지 이 보고서를 반드시 제출해야 해요.
hint: surely, certainly, without fail (used for strong obligation or certainty)
reason: High frequency adverb for obligation and certainty.

meaningEn: to accept, to receive, to embrace
exampleKo: 그의 조언을 받아들이고 계획을 수정하기로 했습니다.
hint: to accept, to receive, to embrace (ideas, offers, situations)
reason: Common verb for accepting concepts or situations.

meaningEn: to take out, to pull out, to bring up (a topic)
exampleKo: 가방에서 책을 꺼내서 읽기 시작했어요.
hint: to take out, to pull out, to bring up (a topic)
reason: Versatile verb with literal and figurative uses.

exampleKo: 모든 노동자는 공정한 대우를 받을 권리가 있습니다.
hint: worker, laborer
reason: Key noun for discussing employment and labor.

exampleKo: 우리 동네에는 맛있는 식당이 많이 있어요.
hint: neighborhood, district, town
reason: Commonly used noun for everyday life contexts.

exampleKo: 저는 그 문제를 완전히 이해하지 못했어요.
hint: completely, entirely, perfectly (emphasizes totality)
reason: Frequent adverb indicating completeness.

meaningEn: to convey, to deliver, to tell, to transmit
exampleKo: 친구에게 제 안부를 꼭 전해주세요.
hint: to convey, to deliver, to tell, to transmit (information, messages)
reason: Essential verb for communication and information transfer.

meaningEn: not particularly, not really (usually with negative)
exampleKo: 이 영화는 별로 재미있지 않았어요.
hint: not particularly, not really (used with negative statements)
reason: Very common adverb for expressing mild negation.

meaningEn: to decide, to determine, to set
exampleKo: 우리는 다음 주 회의 날짜를 정해야 해요.
hint: to decide, to determine, to set (plans, rules, times)
reason: Core verb for decision-making and planning.

exampleKo: 이 공연은 대중들에게 큰 인기를 얻었습니다.
hint: the public, the masses
reason: Important noun for discussing public opinion and culture.

meaningEn: to increase, to grow, to stretch
exampleKo: 최근 스마트폰 사용 시간이 많이 늘어났어요.
hint: to increase, to grow (quantitatively)
reason: Common verb for changes in quantity, useful in various contexts.

meaningEn: various kinds of, all sorts of
exampleKo: 백화점에서는 각종 할인 행사를 진행하고 있습니다.
hint: various kinds of, all sorts of (often precedes nouns)
reason: Useful for describing variety in social and economic contexts.

exampleKo: 어두운 방에 한 줄기 빛이 들어왔어요.
hint: light, ray (can be literal or figurative)
reason: Basic noun with some figurative use, but less critical for TOPIK II.

exampleKo: 야, 너 어디 가? 같이 가자!
hint: Hey!, Oh! (casual address or exclamation)
reason: Too informal and situational for a general TOPIK II deck.

exampleKo: 고고학자들이 오래된 유적을 발견했어요.
hint: to discover, to find (often something previously unknown)
reason: Key verb for scientific and general discovery contexts.

exampleKo: 이 제품의 가장 큰 특징은 휴대하기 쉽다는 것입니다.
hint: characteristic, feature, trait (a distinguishing quality)
reason: Essential for analysis and description in various topics.

exampleKo: 그 선수는 올림픽에서 금메달을 땄어요.
hint: athlete, player (in sports)
reason: Relevant for sports and competition topics, but not universally high-frequency.

meaningEn: to prepare, to arrange, to provide
exampleKo: 손님들을 위해 특별한 저녁 식사를 마련했어요.
hint: to prepare, to arrange, to provide (for a purpose)
reason: Common verb for planning and making arrangements.

meaningEn: to announce, to present, to publish
exampleKo: 다음 주에 새로운 연구 결과를 발표할 예정입니다.
hint: to announce, to present, to publish (information or findings)
reason: Crucial for academic, professional, and public communication.

exampleKo: 오늘 회의의 주제는 신제품 개발입니다.
hint: topic, subject, theme (the main idea or focus)
reason: Fundamental for understanding and discussing any subject matter.

exampleKo: 한국어를 배우려면 기본 문법부터 익혀야 해요.
hint: basic, fundamental; used for foundational knowledge or elements.
reason: Fundamental concept for learning.

exampleKo: 마술사가 눈앞에서 갑자기 사라졌어요.
hint: to disappear, to vanish; describes something ceasing to be visible or present.
reason: Common verb for describing absence.

exampleKo: 그는 자신의 감정을 잘 표현하지 못하는 편이에요.
hint: emotion, feeling, sentiment; refers to inner states of mind.
reason: Key term for social and personal interactions.

exampleKo: 어릴 적 추억은 좋은 기억으로 남아있어요.
hint: memory, recollection; the ability to remember or the thing remembered.
reason: Essential for discussing past events and personal experiences.

exampleKo: 이 가수는 젊은 세대에게 특히 인기가 많아요.
hint: popularity; the state of being liked or admired by many people.
reason: Frequently used in discussions about people and trends.

exampleKo: 이 건물은 관리가 잘 되어서 항상 깨끗해요.
hint: management, administration; the process of controlling or organizing something.
reason: Commonly used in contexts of organization and maintenance.

meaningEn: to be heard; to be lifted, to be carried
exampleKo: 저 멀리서 음악 소리가 들리는데 무슨 노래인지 모르겠어요.
hint: to be heard; passive form of 듣다, indicating sound perception.
reason: Basic verb for sensory experience.

meaningEn: to run; to hang; to lack
exampleKo: 버스를 놓칠까 봐 정류장까지 열심히 달렸어요.
hint: to run; also means to hang or to lack, context is key.
reason: Common verb for movement and action.

exampleKo: 회사가 다음 달에 새 건물로 이전할 예정입니다.
hint: relocation, transfer; also means before or previously.
reason: Important for discussing changes in location or time.

meaningEn: to order (food); to make (someone do something)
exampleKo: 배고파서 중국집에 짜장면을 시켜 먹었어요.
hint: to order (food); to make (someone do something); causative verb.
reason: Very common verb with multiple essential uses.

exampleKo: 한국은 국제 무역에서 중요한 역할을 하고 있습니다.
hint: international; used for global affairs, organizations, or events.
reason: Broadly applicable to global topics in TOPIK II.

exampleKo: 우리 그룹은 다음 주에 프로젝트 발표를 할 거예요.
hint: group; a collection of people or things, often used in work or social contexts.
reason: Commonly used for social and work-related contexts.

exampleKo: 인생은 예측할 수 없는 일들로 가득 차 있어서 재미있어요.
hint: life; refers to the entire period of existence, often used in philosophical or personal reflection.
reason: Essential for discussing personal experiences and life philosophies.

exampleKo: 한국은 아름다운 전통 문화를 많이 가지고 있습니다.
hint: tradition; customs, beliefs, or ways of behaving that have been passed down through generations.
reason: Key term for cultural topics, frequent in TOPIK II.

meaningEn: to raise, to grow, to cultivate
exampleKo: 어릴 때부터 강아지를 기르고 싶었는데 드디어 꿈을 이뤘어요.
hint: to raise, grow, cultivate; used for raising children, pets, plants, or developing skills/qualities.
reason: Versatile verb applicable to various contexts like family, hobbies, and personal development.

meaningEn: to investigate, to survey, to examine
exampleKo: 경찰이 사건의 원인을 철저하게 조사하고 있습니다.
hint: to investigate, survey, examine; to look into something systematically.
reason: Crucial for topics involving research, news, and problem-solving.

meaningEn: to be huge, to be enormous
exampleKo: 공원에는 커다란 나무들이 많아서 산책하기 좋아요.
hint: to be huge, enormous; a descriptive adjective for size.
reason: Descriptive but less critical than abstract or action verbs for TOPIK II writing.

exampleKo: 그는 유명한 시인이 되어서 많은 사람들에게 사랑받고 있습니다.
hint: poet; a person who writes poetry.
reason: Specific profession, less broadly useful than general vocabulary.

exampleKo: 저희 집은 지하철역 바로 옆에 위치해서 교통이 편리해요.
hint: location, position; the place where something is situated.
reason: Useful for describing places and directions, common in reading passages.

meaningEn: to reduce, to decrease, to shorten
exampleKo: 건강을 위해 저녁 식사량을 조금 줄이려고 노력하고 있어요.
hint: to reduce, decrease, shorten; to make something smaller in amount, size, or duration.
reason: Highly versatile verb applicable to various topics like economy, health, and daily life.

exampleKo: 이 핸드폰은 성능이 좋은데도 가격이 아주 저렴해요.
hint: price; often used in contexts of buying, selling, or comparing costs.
reason: Commonly used in economic contexts.

exampleKo: 어제와 오늘 날씨가 완전히 달라져서 옷을 따뜻하게 입었어요.
hint: to change, to become different; describes a transformation or alteration.
reason: Fundamental verb for describing change.

exampleKo: 저는 안정적인 직업을 원해서 공무원 시험을 준비하고 있어요.
hint: to want, to desire; expresses a wish or aspiration.
reason: Expresses desire, common in personal goals.

exampleKo: 요즘은 인터넷 통신 기술이 정말 빠르게 발전하고 있어요.
hint: communication, telecommunication; refers to the exchange of information, especially via technology.
reason: Relevant to modern technology and media.

meaningEn: to confirm, to check, to verify
exampleKo: 출발하기 전에 비행기 시간을 다시 한번 확인해 주세요.
hint: to confirm, to check, to verify; used for ensuring accuracy or correctness.
reason: Essential verb for verification and checking.

exampleKo: 친구들과 오랜만에 모임을 가졌는데 정말 즐거웠어요.
hint: gathering, meeting, get-together; refers to a social assembly.
reason: Key term for social interactions.

exampleKo: 그의 농담 덕분에 회의실에 웃음꽃이 피었어요.
hint: laughter, smile; the expression of amusement or happiness.
reason: Relates to emotions and social expression.

exampleKo: 이 새로운 기계는 이전 모델보다 훨씬 효율적이에요.
hint: machine, machinery; refers to devices or apparatuses.
reason: Commonly appears in discussions of technology and industry.

exampleKo: 그녀는 꿈이었던 방송국 아나운서가 되어서 기뻐했어요.
hint: announcer; a person who announces news or programs on radio or television.
reason: Specific but relevant to media topics.

meaningEn: to spread, to unfold, to open
exampleKo: 책상에 지도를 펴고 여행 계획을 세웠어요.
hint: to spread, to unfold, to open; used for physical objects like maps or books, or abstract concepts like a plan.
reason: Versatile verb with literal and figurative uses.

exampleKo: 한국에는 다양한 종교가 있지만, 불교와 기독교가 가장 흔해요.
hint: religion; used in discussions about beliefs and societal structures.
reason: Relevant for cultural and societal discussions.

meaningEn: to be natural, to be spontaneous
exampleKo: 처음에는 어려웠지만, 이제는 한국말 하는 것이 자연스러워졌어요.
hint: to be natural, spontaneous; describes behavior, speech, or situations.
reason: Widely applicable to describing fluency and behavior.

meaningEn: to turn, to spin, to go around
exampleKo: 아이들이 운동장에서 신나게 뛰어놀고 빙글빙글 돌고 있어요.
hint: to turn, spin, go around; can be literal or figurative (e.g., 'mind is spinning').
reason: Common verb with some figurative use.

exampleKo: 저는 그 사람의 행동을 아직도 완전히 이해할 수 없어요.
hint: understanding, comprehension; crucial for academic and interpersonal contexts.
reason: Fundamental abstract noun for comprehension.

exampleKo: 커피 혹은 차, 둘 중에 어떤 것을 마실래요?
hint: or, alternatively; connects choices or possibilities.
reason: Useful conjunction for expressing alternatives.

meaningEn: to make an effort, to try hard
exampleKo: 한국어를 잘하고 싶어서 매일 꾸준히 노력하고 있어요.
hint: to make an effort, try hard; essential for discussing goals and achievements.
reason: Key verb for discussing effort and goals.

exampleKo: 우리는 환경 보호를 위해 쓰레기를 줄이는 노력을 해야 합니다.
hint: protection, safeguard; often used with environment, rights, or people.
reason: Important for environmental and social topics.

exampleKo: 좋은 이웃과 함께 살면 더 행복한 일상을 보낼 수 있어요.
hint: neighbor, neighborhood; relates to community and social interaction.
reason: Relevant for social and community contexts.

exampleKo: 우리는 공동의 목표를 달성하기 위해 함께 열심히 일하고 있습니다.
hint: common, joint, communal; describes shared aspects or activities.
reason: Useful for discussing shared goals and communities.

exampleKo: 그가 갑자기 화를 낸 까닭을 아직도 모르겠어요.
hint: reason, cause, motive; used to inquire about or explain reasons.
reason: Standard vocabulary for discussing reasons.

exampleKo: 어린 소녀가 길을 잃어버려서 경찰관이 도와주었어요.
hint: young girl (female child)
reason: Common noun for a specific demographic.

meaningEn: to pass by, to go past
exampleKo: 시간이 너무 빨리 지나가서 벌써 저녁이 되었네요.
hint: to pass by (time, people, vehicles)
reason: Versatile verb for movement and time.

exampleKo: 이 백화점에서는 다양한 종류의 고급 상품을 팔고 있어요.
hint: product, goods (items for sale)
reason: Essential for economic and consumer contexts.

meaningEn: to be excellent, to be splendid, to be great
exampleKo: 그 학생은 항상 열심히 공부해서 훌륭한 성적을 받아요.
hint: excellent, great (high quality, admirable)
reason: High-frequency adjective for praise and evaluation.

meaningEn: newly, afresh, for the first time
exampleKo: 우리는 새로 이사한 집을 예쁘게 꾸미기 위해 노력하고 있어요.
hint: newly, afresh (indicating a new beginning or state)
reason: Common adverb for new actions or states.

exampleKo: 이 가게에는 여러 종류의 과일과 채소가 아주 많아요.
hint: kind, sort, type (classification)
reason: Fundamental for categorization and description.

meaningEn: to raise, to grow, to nurture
exampleKo: 저는 어렸을 때 강아지를 키우면서 많은 추억을 만들었어요.
hint: to raise, grow, nurture (living things, plants)
reason: Common verb for raising and growing.

exampleKo: 너무 피곤해서 침대에 눕자마자 잠이 들었어요.
hint: to lie down (horizontal position)
reason: Basic verb for physical posture.

meaningEn: to develop, to grow, to progress
exampleKo: 이 지역은 교통 시스템이 잘 발달해서 생활하기 편리해요.
hint: to develop, grow (physically, intellectually, technologically)
reason: Important for describing growth and progress in various fields.

meaningEn: to develop, to progress, to advance
exampleKo: 한국은 짧은 시간 안에 경제적으로 크게 발전했습니다.
hint: to develop, progress, advance (societal, economic, technological)
reason: Key term for progress and advancement, especially in societal contexts.

exampleKo: 삶과 죽음은 모든 생명체에게 피할 수 없는 운명입니다.
hint: death; often contrasted with life (삶)
reason: Abstract concept, relevant to life/death discussions.

exampleKo: 사고로 다친 사람들은 큰 고통 속에서 치료를 받고 있습니다.
hint: pain, suffering; physical or emotional distress
reason: Commonly used for describing hardship and suffering.

meaningEn: to get along with, to suit, to match
exampleKo: 그 옷이 정말 잘 어울리니까 꼭 사세요!
hint: to suit, match; often used for clothes or people fitting in
reason: High frequency in daily conversation and descriptions.

meaningEn: to inform, to notify, to let know
exampleKo: 중요한 소식이 있으면 저에게 꼭 미리 알려주세요.
hint: to inform, notify; to make something known
reason: Essential verb for communication and information sharing.

exampleKo: 저는 주말에 도시를 떠나 멀리 여행을 가고 싶어요.
hint: far, distantly; adverb indicating distance
reason: Common adverb for describing distance or separation.

meaningEn: to take out, to remove, to subtract
exampleKo: 서랍에서 중요한 서류를 빼서 사장님께 드렸어요.
hint: to remove, take out, subtract; versatile verb
reason: Broadly applicable verb with multiple common uses.

exampleKo: 회의는 다음 주 월요일 오전 10시로 예정되어 있습니다.
hint: schedule, plan, expectation; noun indicating a future arrangement
reason: Crucial for discussing plans and schedules.

exampleKo: 이 지역에서는 여름에 소나기가 흔히 내려요.
hint: commonly, often; adverb indicating frequency
reason: Useful adverb for describing common occurrences.

meaningEn: to be felt, to be perceived
exampleKo: 따뜻한 햇살이 피부에 부드럽게 느껴졌어요.
hint: to be felt, perceived; passive form of 느끼다
reason: Describes sensory and emotional perception.

exampleKo: 그는 컴퓨터 프로그래밍이 전문이라서 어려운 문제도 잘 해결해요.
hint: specialty, major; area of expertise
reason: Key term for discussing careers and education.

meaningEn: to be accurate, to be precise, to be exact
exampleKo: 이 시계는 시간이 아주 정확해서 믿을 수 있어요.
hint: to be accurate, precise. Used for information, judgment, time, etc.
reason: Useful for describing data and making precise statements.

meaningEn: etc., and so on, back (of body)
exampleKo: 사과, 바나나, 오렌지 등 다양한 과일을 팔고 있어요.
hint: etc., and so on. Used to list examples and indicate continuation.
reason: Essential for listing examples and generalizing.

meaningEn: to come to visit, to come to find
exampleKo: 멀리서 친구가 저를 찾아와서 오랜만에 함께 저녁을 먹었어요.
hint: to come to visit, to come to find. Often used for people visiting someone.
reason: Common verb for social interactions and visits.

exampleKo: 휴대폰을 너무 많이 사용하면 눈이 나빠질 수 있어요.
hint: use, usage. Refers to the act of using something.
reason: Fundamental noun for discussing tools, technology, and resources.

exampleKo: 우리는 다음 주에 여행 갈 장소를 빨리 결정해야 해요.
hint: to decide, to determine. Making a choice or judgment.
reason: Key verb for decision-making in various contexts.

exampleKo: 그 회사의 경영 방식은 항상 혁신적이라고 평가받아요.
hint: management, administration. Refers to the running of a business or organization.
reason: Relevant for economic and professional contexts.

exampleKo: 올해의 가장 큰 목표는 한국어 능력 시험 5급에 합격하는 것입니다.
hint: goal, target, objective. What one aims to achieve.
reason: Essential for discussing aspirations and plans.

exampleKo: 주말에 가족들과 함께 아름다운 숲으로 캠핑을 갔어요.
hint: forest, woods. A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.
reason: Common noun for describing nature and outdoor settings.

meaningEn: to disappear, to vanish, to be lost
exampleKo: 어제 샀던 열쇠가 갑자기 없어져서 찾고 있어요.
hint: to disappear, to vanish, to be lost. The state of no longer being present.
reason: Useful for describing changes in state and loss.

meaningEn: to rise, to float up, to come to mind
exampleKo: 갑자기 좋은 생각이 머릿속에 떠올랐어요.
hint: to rise, to float up, to come to mind. Can be literal (sun) or figurative (idea).
reason: Versatile verb for literal rising and figurative emergence of thoughts.

meaningEn: to reach, to extend, to affect, to influence
exampleKo: 그의 연구 결과는 사회 전반에 큰 영향을 미쳤어요.
hint: to reach, extend, affect (often used with '영향')
reason: Commonly used verb with abstract concepts like influence and scope.

exampleKo: 저는 매일 새벽 5시에 일어나서 운동을 시작해요.
hint: dawn, daybreak (time)
reason: Common noun for a specific time of day, useful in descriptions.

exampleKo: 비가 오기 전에 얼른 집에 가야 해요.
hint: quickly, promptly (adverb)
reason: Frequent adverb indicating speed, useful in narratives.

exampleKo: 이 회사는 다른 회사보다 임금이 높아서 인기가 많아요.
hint: wages, pay, salary (economic term)
reason: Key term in economic discussions, relevant to jobs and work.

meaningEn: to be scary, to be frightening, to be afraid
exampleKo: 밤에 혼자 숲길을 걷는 것은 좀 무서워요.
hint: to be scary, frightening, afraid (emotion/state)
reason: Common adjective for expressing fear or danger.

exampleKo: 새로운 직장에 적응하는 데 시간이 좀 걸렸어요.
hint: workplace, job (location/status)
reason: Essential vocabulary for discussing employment and careers.

meaningEn: to bear, to endure, to suppress
exampleKo: 화가 나도 꾹 참는 것이 중요하다고 생각해요.
hint: to bear, endure, suppress (action)
reason: Important verb for expressing self-control and resilience.

exampleKo: 이 옷은 제게 너무 커서 작은 크기로 바꿔야 할 것 같아요.
hint: size, dimension (measurement)
reason: Basic but useful noun for describing physical attributes.

meaningEn: to leave (behind), to save, to leave (a message)
exampleKo: 식사 후에 음식을 조금도 남기지 않고 다 먹었어요.
hint: to leave (behind), save, leave (a message) (action)
reason: Versatile verb with common applications in daily life and records.

exampleKo: 서양 문화와 동양 문화는 서로 다른 점이 많아요.
hint: the West, Western countries (geographical/cultural)
reason: Common term for discussing cultural comparisons.

exampleKo: 이 책은 한국 역사의 주요 사건들을 다루고 있습니다.
hint: main, principal, major; often modifies nouns like 'events', 'reasons', 'factors'.
reason: High frequency, broadly applicable modifier.

meaningEn: to be excessive, to be extreme
exampleKo: 너무 지나친 걱정은 건강에 좋지 않아요.
hint: to be excessive, to be extreme; describes actions, emotions, or quantities that go beyond a reasonable limit.
reason: Commonly used to describe negative extremes.

exampleKo: 맛있는 음식 냄새가 나서 배가 고파졌어요.
hint: smell, odor, scent; can be positive or negative, referring to the scent of food, places, or things.
reason: Basic sensory noun, useful in everyday contexts.

meaningEn: to be soft, to be smooth, to be gentle
exampleKo: 이 스웨터는 정말 부드러워서 입기 좋아요.
hint: to be soft, to be smooth, to be gentle; describes texture, sound, personality, or touch.
reason: Versatile adjective for describing textures and qualities.

exampleKo: 주말에 친구와 함께 뮤지컬 공연을 보러 갈 거예요.
hint: performance, show; refers to artistic presentations like concerts, plays, musicals, etc.
reason: Key term for cultural activities.

meaningEn: to put out, to release, to present
exampleKo: 새로운 디자인의 휴대폰을 다음 달에 내놓을 예정입니다.
hint: to put out, to release, to present; often used for products, ideas, or results.
reason: Useful for discussing new products or presenting information.

meaningEn: to detach, to remove, to take off
exampleKo: 벽에 붙어 있던 포스터를 조심스럽게 떼어냈어요.
hint: to detach, to remove, to take off; used for physically separating things or removing something from a list/group.
reason: Common verb for removal actions.

meaningEn: to be made, to be created
exampleKo: 이 가방은 수작업으로 특별하게 만들어진 것입니다.
hint: to be made, to be created; passive form of 만들다, focusing on the origin or process of creation.
reason: Passive voice construction is important for describing origins.

exampleKo: 차가 너무 빠른 속도로 달려서 위험해 보였어요.
hint: speed, pace, velocity; refers to the rate of movement or progress.
reason: Fundamental concept in science and everyday descriptions.

meaningEn: to be serious, to be severe, to be grave
exampleKo: 환경 오염 문제는 전 세계적으로 매우 심각합니다.
hint: to be serious, to be severe, to be grave; used to describe problems, situations, or consequences that are very important or dangerous.
reason: Essential adjective for discussing serious issues.

exampleKo: 지난주부터 비가 계속되어서 야외 활동을 못 했어요.
hint: to continue, to be continued (used for ongoing states or actions)
reason: Common verb for ongoing situations, useful in many contexts.

exampleKo: 그 소년은 매일 도서관에 가서 책을 읽어요.
hint: boy, youth (refers to a young male)
reason: Basic noun for describing people, relevant in narratives.

exampleKo: 오랜만에 친구에게서 좋은 소식을 들었어요.
hint: news, tidings, word (information received)
reason: Frequently used for communication and information exchange.

exampleKo: 많은 후보자들 중에서 그가 그중 가장 유능해 보였습니다.
hint: among them, out of them (refers to a subset of a previously mentioned group)
reason: Useful connective adverb for comparisons and selections.

exampleKo: 버스에서 노인에게 자리를 양보하는 것이 좋아요.
hint: elderly person, senior citizen (refers to an old person)
reason: Common term for a demographic group, relevant in social contexts.

exampleKo: 아르바이트를 해서 다음 학기 등록금을 벌어야 해요.
hint: to earn (money), to make (money) (refers to acquiring income)
reason: Essential verb for discussing work and finances.

meaningEn: to save (a life), to make good use of
exampleKo: 우리는 버려질 위기에 처한 동물을 살리기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
hint: to save (a life), to make good use of (to preserve or utilize effectively)
reason: Versatile verb with literal and figurative meanings, important for various topics.

exampleKo: 중요한 결정을 내리기 전에 충분히 생각해야 해요.
hint: decision, determination (the act or result of deciding)
reason: Key abstract noun for discussing choices and outcomes.

meaningEn: to slice, to chop, to cut
exampleKo: 요리하기 전에 양파와 당근을 잘게 썰어주세요.
hint: to slice, to chop, to cut (to cut into pieces)
reason: Common verb related to food preparation, relevant in daily life contexts.

exampleKo: 좋은 인상을 주기 위해 첫 만남에서는 이미지가 중요해요.
hint: image, impression (a general feeling or idea about someone or something)
reason: Widely used noun in discussions about perception and branding.

exampleKo: 오늘 업무가 너무 많아서 야근해야 할 것 같아요.
hint: task, duty, work; often used in professional contexts.
reason: Core vocabulary for work and professional life.

exampleKo: 청소년들을 위한 다양한 교육 프로그램이 필요합니다.
hint: adolescent, teenager, youth; refers to the age group.
reason: Important social term related to age groups.

exampleKo: "이거 네 꺼야?" "응, 내 거야."
hint: yes (informal), yeah, uh-huh; casual affirmative response.
reason: Too informal and basic for TOPIK II extension.

meaningEn: to win, to defeat, to overcome
exampleKo: 우리 팀이 마침내 어려운 경기를 이겨서 기뻤어요.
hint: to win, to defeat, to overcome; used in competitions, arguments, or overcoming challenges.
reason: Common verb for winning and overcoming.

meaningEn: to look for, to search for, to visit
exampleKo: 궁금한 점이 있으면 인터넷에서 정보를 찾아볼 수 있어요.
hint: to look for, to search for, to visit; implies active searching for information or places.
